verdict.rationale: Pipecat Cloud publishes a documented public REST API. It ships as a downloadable OpenAPI 3.0 spec with a public API (start sessions, proxy requests) and a private API (manage agents, secrets, builds, regions, org settings), plus a per-endpoint "Try it" playground with cURL examples, so an AI-native user can drive the product programmatically. The probe's 404s were only at guessed paths; the spec lives at the documented REST-reference path. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of actually calling the REST API.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: The public API (/v1/public, authenticated with a public API key) starts agent sessions and proxies requests to them. The private API (/v1...) manages agents, secrets, builds, regions, and organization settings.
Download the complete spec to generate clients, run mocks, or feed to AI tools.
The Pipecat Cloud REST reference renders a live "Try it" API playground per endpoint
